name: How long does an insulation upgrade project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an insulation upgrade project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an insulation upgrade project depends on the scope of work. A simple attic re-insulation might take a day or two, while a whole-home insulation project, especially involving wall cavity insulation or existing insulation removal, could take several days to a week. Factors like weather conditions and accessibility of the work areas also play a role. Hometelligent Inc. provides a clear project timeline during the initial consultation, outlining what to expect before, during, and after the service to ensure process clarity for our clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope; simple attic work may take days, while whole-home projects can take a week.
